goal: Freeze target, measurement, cashflow, and deterministic hurdle semantics before comparing strategies.
objective_status: investor-declared planning objective; not a guarantee or approved risk limit

success_measurement.default_analysis_measure: net accessible after-tax wealth under a predeclared measurement-date valuation and liquidation policy, expressed in 2026 INR
success_measurement.success_rule: success when measured real accessible wealth is greater than or equal to the named target

event_distinctions.valuation: marked value before a sale; alone it is not settled proceeds and must retain a valuation source and tax/liquidation treatment
event_distinctions.sale: executed disposal; creates realized proceeds, transaction costs, and potentially taxable events; execution is not settlement
event_distinctions.settled_access: cleared proceeds and retained liquid assets after modeled costs and tax liabilities; the default success measurement unless the investor confirms another policy

success_measurement.tax_and_cost_accounting: include taxes on earlier taxable income and the modeled exit; track whether taxes are paid from or outside the portfolio to avoid double counting
investor_confirmation_required: first SIP date and payment timing
2036 measurement month and permitted partial-liquidation policy
whether success requires settled cash or permits specified retained assets
actual account, product, and implementation constraints

illustrative_cashflow_fixture.date_status: illustrative model convention; exact investor dates remain unconfirmed
illustrative_cashflow_fixture.rounding_status: mathematical schedule precision from frozen CSV; actual bank/broker payment rounding remains unconfirmed

inflation_scenarios.base_cpi_status: assumed reference month; observed investor CPI anchor not confirmed
inflation_scenarios.fractional_year_convention: annual_factor ^ (horizon_months / 12); monthly cashflows are deflated by the same compound path to the assumed base month

included: constant monthly gross return needed to reach the nominalized target under the illustrative dated cashflows
equivalent effective annual real return under each CPI scenario
independent solution in real purchasing-power cashflows
local derivatives of required hurdle versus target and CPI assumption
excluded: taxes, fees, spreads, and other costs
instrument availability, eligibility, and return feasibility
return volatility, sequence risk, probability, confidence intervals, and model uncertainty
deterministic_hurdle_scope.interpretation: pre-tax/pre-cost arithmetic hurdle only; it is not an expected return, sufficient after-tax hurdle, or likelihood estimate
deterministic_hurdle_scope.after_tax_hurdle_status: requires strategy-specific instrument, cashflow, tax, fee, and exit-policy paths; no single investor-specific hurdle is asserted here

continuous_question_and_challenge_record.claim_under_test: A hurdle calculation can tell us what constant gross return the illustrative cashflow schedule would need to reach the nominalized amount corresponding to a real target.
continuous_question_and_challenge_record.material_question: Would meeting that hurdle establish that the investor's after-tax real objective is likely or achievable with a suitable portfolio?
continuous_question_and_challenge_record.strongest_countercase: No. The calculation assumes a constant return and excludes sequence risk, fees, taxes, instrument eligibility, future tax law, and investor-specific exit timing. A mark-to-market target may also differ from settled after-tax wealth.
falsification_checks: independently solve the same hurdle from CPI-deflated dated cashflows and compare the real annual hurdle
reconstruct terminal nominal and real values independently at the solved rates
compare the planning-floor results with the existing deterministic baseline
finite-difference check the analytic target and CPI sensitivities
continuous_question_and_challenge_record.disposition: The result is an arithmetic requirement only. It cannot support a probability, forecast, recommendation, or investment authorization.
invalidation_triggers: CPI base month or scenario changes
